questions.question: Which Indian state recently launched an action plan to reduce salt intake by 30% by the year 2030?

questions.question: Which Kadapa-based company recently shipped its first 345 kV power transformer to the U.S., targeting ₹600 crore in exports?

questions.question: According to the University of Chicago-based Climate Impact Lab, this year’s El Niño-driven heat could cause how many additional deaths globally?
